top_signals.title: Russian national facing 20 years for malware campaign that infected 80,000 freelancers
top_signals.summary: Searzhudin Tamirlanovich Aktulaev appeared in a San Francisco federal court on Monday after being arrested in Cyprus in May 2025 and extradited to the U.S. last week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: August Jobs Report Favors a Fed Rate Hike, Sahm Says
top_signals.summary: Claudia Sahm, chief economist at New Century Advisors, reacts to the US employment report for August. She says this jobs report favors Federal Reserve officials that want to start hiking rates. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Global bond sell-off likely not over yet, Mohamed El-Erian tells CNBC
top_signals.summary: In a wide-ranging interview, the renowned economist also said the U.S. Treasury had taken "a step too far" with its market intervention.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Anti-Drone Firm APS Said to Mull Options Including Possible Sale
top_signals.summary: Polish anti-drone company Advanced Protection Systems is in the early stages of exploring strategic options, which may include a potential sale, people with knowledge of the matter said.
